test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Miarage**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of '**Miarage**' according to the English dictionary__ is '**Mirage**'.
 
• The word '**Mirage**' means '**an image you think you see in very hot weather, for example water in a desert, but which does not really exist**'.
 
• Hence, the **most appropriate** answer is '**Miarage**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the meaning of the other options.
 
 
• **Missing**- lost, or not in the right or usual place.
 
• **Mistaken**- to be wrong about something.
 
• **Mission**- an important official job that somebody is sent somewhere to do, especially to another country.
